prompt: A wall-mounted COMMODITY SPOT-PRICE BOARD glowing above a bank's commodity trading desk, traders at screens in the foreground. Use the real settlement prices for the 2026-07-16 session (the pinned quotes for this board). Lay it out as a tidy dark dashboard, one row per commodity: GOLD (US$ per troy ounce), SILVER (US$ per troy ounce), and WTI CRUDE OIL (US$ per barrel), each printed with its real price. Then, below a divider, print the GOLD/SILVER RATIO -- the number of ounces of silver that equals one ounce of gold, i.e. the gold price DIVIDED BY the silver price -- as a single number to one decimal. Use the REAL market prices, and make the printed ratio actually equal gold price divided by silver price. Crisp aligned columns, every label, price and the ratio sharp and legible.
